score.rubric-served.say: The rubric is what the run was served. It is never stored: pass what came back from the run.

score.not-a-number.say: <what>.<name> is <value> where a number is needed

score.unusable.say:
unusable-rubric: this rubric holds something that is not a number where one is needed:
  <problems>
Nothing was scored. A score computed from a rubric nothing checked is a number nobody should act on.

score.nothing.say: nothing-to-score: this run neither read nor found anything from <pack>, and this rubric scores that pack. A run that read nothing has not scored well. Say what it read, and give it no number it did not earn.
